global: A bowl of spicy ramen broth, rich and reddish-orange, cradles curly noodles and fresh green lettuce leaves arranged in a central mound. The white bowl with gray floral patterns rests on a wooden surface under soft, even lighting.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and smooth texture beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with gray floral and phoenix pattern, smooth glossy surface, slightly raised rim.
regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with curly noodles and fresh lettuce leaves, rich reddish-brown color, glossy surface.
